## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed screening activity during January 2019, with 357 captures recorded. The volume reflects the activity submitted for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No other operational issues were noted in the available report.

## Image quality

There were 20 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 5.6 per cent. This result should be monitored as part of routine site performance review, with attention to any recurring issues affecting image capture. The available information does not identify a further breakdown of the ungradable images.

## Grading

Grading identified 54 referable results from the month’s activity. The median lag from photograph to grade was 10 days. This measure indicates the central turnaround time for grading and should be considered alongside the site’s overall activity and image-quality results. The reported findings provide a concise summary of service delivery at Market Eye Clinic during January 2019.
